{{Quote|The Great Galactic War dragged on for decades. Thousands of Jedi and Sith were slain. Countless star systems were ravaged.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=GreatWarDraggedOn.flac|<ref name="Timeline 1" />}}
The '''Great Galactic War''', known as the '''Great War''' or '''Republic&ndash;Sith War''', was a twenty-eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] between [[3681 BBY]] and [[3653 BBY]]. The war was the culmination of a 1300-year grudge held by survivors of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|original Sith Empire]] against the Republic for their defeat in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].

The war would cost countless lives and devastate worlds from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rim]], as well as having dramatic galactic consequences otherwise. The Republic economy was shattered, its [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|leader]] dead, and its [[Galactic City/Legends|capital]] in ruins, while roughly half [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] would end up under [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] dominion. Furthermore, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] would withdraw from the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to establish a new home on their ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

But it would not ultimately be conclusive. While a strategic defeat for the Republic, the end of the war left both powers standing, engaged in an [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|undeclared conflict]] for supremacy on numerous disputed worlds.

==Background==
{{Quote|You must go where Revan did, into the Unknown Regions, where the Sith, the true Sith, wait in the dark for the great war that comes.|[[Kreia]], to [[Meetra Surik]]|audio=KreiaTrueSith.flac|<ref name="KOTOR 2" />}}
With the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Second battle of Korriban|defeat]] in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] decided how to deal with their fallen enemy: [[Pultimo|Supreme Chancellor Pultimo]] ordered the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|exterminate]] all remnants of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Gnost" /> But one [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and a group of survivors [[Sith exodus|escaped]] the Republic's slaughter of their kind and fled to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. There, he [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|re-founded the Empire]], assumed the title of [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], and created a [[Dark Council|council of other Sith Lords]] to rule under him. Using the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], the Emperor kept himself alive for over a thousand years after the Great Hyperspace War, rebuilding the Empire's strength and promising his people revenge on the Republic and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

The Republic, meanwhile, was challenged in a number of wars over the next few thousand years. After the [[Great Sith War/Legends|war]] with [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]],<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> the Sith Empire goaded the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to [[Mandalorian Wars|attack the Republic]].<ref name="Revan" /> A [[Revanchist|group of Jedi]], led by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], soon joined the Republic forces in their war against the Mandalorians.<ref name="KOTORcomic">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]]</ref><ref name="KOTOR" /> During the war, Revan traveled to the [[Trayus Academy|ancient Sith academy]] on [[Malachor V]], where the final [[Battle of Malachor V|battle]] of the Mandalorian Wars would later take place.<ref name="CotOR">{{LucasArts|url=games/swkotor_sithlords|text=''Chronicles of the Old Republic''|int=Chronicles of the Old Republic}}</ref> During his time there, he learned of the true Sith's [[Mission to Dromund Kaas|existence]] in the Unknown Regions.<ref name="KOTOR 2" /> He then used the [[Star Forge]], a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] artifact, to start a war with the Republic<ref name="KOTOR" /> to prepare for the Sith Empire's invasion, resulting in the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR 2" /> The Republic was also burdened by the upheaval of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===The Sith Empire prepares for war===
The Sith Emperor had begun planning an invasion of the Republic as early as [[3960 BBY]], nearly three centuries before the war began. These initial plans were delayed thanks in large part to the efforts of the legendary redeemed Jedi, Revan.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

But the Empire would not be dormant in the following years. The Emperor's war preparations continued nonetheless, with only the timing of the invasion postponed. Two and a half centuries of military build-up would happen before a shift to direct preparations for invasion.<ref name="Gnost" /> After such a lengthy build-up, the Sith fleet had grown to enormous numbers; and now Imperial agents had begun to operate in secret, arranging alliances both within and outside of Republic space.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

Imperial operatives were successful in securing an alliance with the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], as well as installing puppet governments in key positions in the Republic's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] systems. Before a shot had been fired, the Empire had already secretly brought the [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]], [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]], and [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] systems of the [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sector]] under its control. These would prove to be vital assets for the Empire in the early days of the war.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

As invasion drew nearer, the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy's]] war games would reach a fever pitch&mdash;military exercises became a daily event. On the eve of war, the Imperial fleet gathered in key staging locations just outside of Republic space,<ref name="Gnost" /> and in the year [[3681 BBY]], the Sith Emperor ordered the invasion of the Republic.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==War==
===Return of the Sith===
{{Quote|Horrifying reports from the Outer Rim seemed to portend the utter destruction of the Republic.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] describes the Sith onslaught|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
====Fall of Korriban====
{{Quote|Regrettably, Korriban fell back into Imperial hands without the Jedi Council even knowing about it.|Master Gnost-Dural speaks of the [[Battle of Korriban]]|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
For centuries, the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] homeworld [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] had been guarded by a vigil of Jedi and a fairly small contingent of [[Republic trooper]]s. At the onset of the war this garrison was overseen by Jedi Master [[Kao Cen Darach]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="Gnost" /><ref name="Return">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>

[[File:Fall_of_Korriban_TOR.png|thumb|right|280px|The Imperial fleet liberates Korriban]]
In a move which caught the Republic defenders completely by surprise, a Sith fleet of over 30 warships launched a massive assault on their long-occupied holy world Korriban. The Republic and Jedi defenders quickly fell to the Imperial attack, while [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] and his apprentice [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]] battled Jedi defenders Darach and Shan on the orbital station.<ref name="Return" />

Shan escaped the fighting on orders from her master, but Darach was slain in a lightsaber duel by Malgus. With a minimal effort due to overwhelming force, Korriban was captured by Imperial forces and brought under Imperial dominion once more. The attack was so successful that an extended period of time passed before the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] even learned of Korriban's loss.<ref name="Timeline 6" /><ref name="Return" />

====Assault on the Tingel Arm region====
As yet unaware of the fall of Korriban, the appearance of Imperial battlecruisers in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] and [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] was a mystery to the Republic. Naively hoping to resolve the unexpected situation quickly, the Republic dispatched a lightly escorted diplomatic team to find out what was happening.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

The Emperor saw this as an excellent opportunity to begin a campaign of psychological warfare. The Imperial fleet waited for the Republic's diplomatic team to come to them, and then allowed just enough time to transmit images of their armada back to their superiors before utterly [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|destroying them]].<ref name="Timeline 6" />

In response to the threat, the Republic immediately mobilized a fleet to the besieged area in the Tingel Arm. Arriving in proximity to Belkadan, Ruuria, and Sernpidal, the first Republic war fleet found itself ensnared in the Empire's trap. Surrounded by Imperial warships and turncoat allies, the Republic fleet was forced to scatter and retreat to [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] in order to avoid complete annihilation.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

====Destruction of the Sluis Van shipyards====
With the capture of the Tingel Arm and the rout of the Republic forces there, the Sith Empire turned its sights on a valuable new target: the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. Sluis Van was the home of significant Republic [[Sluis Van Shipyards|starship manufacturing facilities]] which presented a tempting target for the invading Imperial forces.

[[File:Sluis_ggw.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Sith fighters devastate the Sluis Van shipyards]]
The Imperial naval forces quickly moved on Sluis Van, which was entirely undefended with the Republic forces still scattered. Various [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Sith starfighter]] squadrons [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|attacked the shipyards]] and destroyed the orbital ring that made up the station.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

The Sith forces continued to press, and conquered the world itself. Much as would continue to be the case as the war pressed on, the Imperial forces executed any civilian or government workers who refused to swear fealty to the Empire. The token Republic military personnel were not granted such mercy, they were simply hunted down and summarily executed as enemies of the Empire.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

====Republic response====
Despite the violence of the attacks, not all [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] were convinced of the threat they faced. Some in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] argued that the attackers were simply another upstart species who could be defeated if only the military could devise an effective strategy. While this faction did not ''control'' the Senate, it was enough that the body was paralyzed by indecision.<ref name="Gnost" />

The Jedi, by contrast, took more decisive action. As the ancient enemies of the Sith, the Jedi Order recognized the threat for what it was and dispatched a force to attempt to defend the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. The Jedi hoped that their action would spur the Republic into action, and indeed they were successful in doing so. After witnessing the heroism of the Jedi on the news feeds, lines began to form at countless recruitment centers across the Republic.<ref name="Gnost" />

As the public clamored for action, the Senate came together and began proper planning for war. Though having already faced a number of defeats, the Republic rallied to defend itself from the attack. Even as the Senate and populace prepared, the Jedi forces already active in the Minos Cluster dug into defensive positions on several worlds, including [[Eliad]].<ref name="Gnost" />

Even as the struggle for Minos continued, the Republic attempted to counterattack in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. The Empire had blockaded the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] there, strangling the flow of supplies to Republic troops at Minos. While the initial attack was unsuccessful, the Republic fleet was able to regroup and break the blockade, allowing much-needed supplies to resume traveling to the besieged Minos Cluster soldiers.<ref name="Gnost" />

====Battle of Korriban====
Three years into the war, in [[3678 BBY]], a [[Exal Kressh|rogue Sith apprentice]] leaked information on Imperial fleet movements to the Republic. In truth, Kressh was only interested in causing the battle in order to create a diversion so that she could pursue her own personal goals.<ref name="Blood">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]''</ref>

Republic forces moved quickly to attack the Sith's holy world. [[Battle over Korriban|A battle erupted]] in orbit between the invading Republic forces and the Sith garrison of starships left to guard the planet.<ref name="Blood" />

But the Republic's first counter-offensive quickly turned into a rout, and then a crushing defeat. The Republic invasion force was overwhelmed by the Sith defenders and crushed, leaving only prisoners and the dead.<ref name="Blood" />

====Battle of Balmorra====
[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], a world renowned galaxy-wide for its [[Droid/Legends|droid]]- and military-manufacturing capabilities, was targeted for conquest by the Sith Empire early in the war. [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|An invasion soon followed]].<ref name="Threat of Peace" />

Shortly after the invasion began, the native Balmorrans organized a [[Balmorran resistance|resistance group]] to defend their world. The Republic soon recognized the threat of the Empire controlling the manufacturing capabilities of Balmorra and launched its own counter-attack as well.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

The struggle would become the most protracted and enduring of the entire war. Though the Republic would eventually be forced to reassign its military assets to other fronts in the war, the Balmorran resistance would maintain the fight throughout the decades of the war and even into the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

====Battles for the Outer Rim====
[[File:Fleeing_civilians.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Republic civilians flee the forces of the Empire]]
The Sith went on to seize many worlds in the Outer Rim and the rich resources of the Minos Cluster. Battlegrounds included [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], the latter seeing its surface cities destroyed, despite attempts to remain neutral. The Republic was further defeated at [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] and [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. After nearly a decade of fighting, [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] estimated that the Empire controlled nearly half of the Outer Rim.<ref name="Gnost" />

===Stalemate===
{{Quote|Neither pride nor foolhardiness drove the defenders' decision. They were guided by the Force. They had passed beyond the fear of death. Their glorious last stand will never be forgotten. Allusis and his men fell, but not before the Imperials were driven to retreat. The Battle of Bothawui was a draw.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 5" />}}
====Republic victories at Bothawui====
After a decade of conquering the Outer Rim, ending with the capture of the Seswenna sector, the Sith advance moved toward assaulting the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Believing the Republic was still recovering from its losses, the Empire rashly sent an invasion force to the planet [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. However, for the first time since the war started, the Republic was well-prepared for defense. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Greik]] had anticipated the attack and, in a risky maneuver, gathered the entire Republic fleet over Bothawui.<ref name="Gnost" /> The Imperial attackers were caught completely off guard and utterly obliterated at the [[First Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="Timeline 5" />

After ten years of defeats, the Republic had finally claimed its first significant victory over the Imperial war machine. The news of the victory proved a great boon, rekindling hope and generally increasing morale throughout the besieged Republic.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

[[File:FirstBattleofBothawui-GGW.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Republic victory at the First Battle of Bothawui]]
The sweetness of victory, however, would be short-lived. Seeking vengeance for their humiliating defeat, the Empire sent a much larger force back to Bothawui. With powerful planetary shields in place, the Republic defenders, led by Jedi Master [[Belth Allusis]], were able to force the Imperial forces into a ground battle.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

An Imperial army of 50,000 soldiers descended on the planet and engaged in [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|one of the bloodiest battles of the war]]. Imperial forces lost, on average, 10 soldiers for every one of the Republic's they killed. While the Imperial commanders were forced to call for reinforcements due to the losses, the Republic defenders stood defiant to the last man&ndash;despite an offer of safety if they were to surrender.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

The Imperial victory was pyrrhic. While they succeeded in destroying the Republic forces, Master Allusis and his forces inflicted such damage on the invading Imperials that they were forced to retreat. The Second Battle of Bothawui was ultimately a draw in terms of material gain and loss, but the heroic sacrifice of Allusis and his troops gave Republic troops galaxy-wide a memory around which to rally.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

In retrospect after the war, scholars such as Master Gnost-Dural would come to identify the victory at Bothawui as the only eventual outcome of the war; that the Republic's only hope in the face of the Sith onslaught was survival, not victory.<ref name="Timeline 5" />

====Capture of the Dread Masters====
[[File:Dread_Masters.png|thumb|right|200px|The Dread Masters]]
In [[3668 BBY]], Republic warships began mysteriously disappearing by the dozens. Investigations by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Republic SIS]] learned that a group of Sith known as the [[Dread Masters]] were using a form of [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to project terror on the crews of Republic ships, making them flee in fear.<ref name="Gnost" /><ref name="TOR" />

For thirteen years of open warfare, the group avoided compromise by consistently being on the move aboard an Imperial dreadnaught. But after learning of their existence, an elite Republic strike team led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] was able to [[Capture of the Dread Masters|infiltrate the Dread Masters' ship]] and capture them, as well as gathering valuable intelligence from the dreadnaught's computers before destroying the ship.

The Republic announced publicly that the strike had killed the Emperor's valued agents, but they had secretly spirited away to the Republic prison planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] when the Jedi learned that the Dread Masters were centuries old and decided they were too valuable to simply execute. The group of dangerous Sith Lords had been removed from the conflict, and would not be an operational threat to the Republic for the remainder of the war.<ref name="Gnost" />

The intelligence obtained in the Dread Masters mission would prove enlightening to both Republic Intelligence and Jedi scholars alike. The war had been on for 13 years and the Republic finally learnt that the Imperial capital was situated on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], a world unknown even in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. The Jedi also learned that the Sith Emperor was, as had been rumored, many centuries old and a survivor of the original Sith Empire.<ref name="Gnost" />

====Battle of Alderaan====
[[File:Invasion_of_Alderaan.png|thumb|left|250px|Imperial troops on the move on Alderaan]]
[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was a world renowned as the embodiment of all the principles upon which the Republic rested. This, paired with its being located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], made it an ideal target for the Imperial advance. Not only would it be a key strategic position within the Core, the capture of Alderaan would be a crushing blow to Republic morale.<ref name="Gnost" />

The mission to conquer Alderaan was spearheaded by Malgus, by that point a seasoned veteran of the war, and recently granted the title of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]]. After luring Alderaan's Republic defense fleet away from the world, Malgus and his army [[Battle of Alderaan|unleashed their attack]], hoping for a swift victory. Malgus was not aware, however, that the Republic had a sizeable garrison of troopers on the planet surface. In addition to being a stopover rest point for soldiers traveling from the Rim back to the Core, the elite [[Havoc Squad]] was on the planet as well.<ref name="Gnost" /><ref name="Hope" />

As on countless other worlds over the past 14 years, a desperate struggle for control of the planet erupted. The Imperial advance claimed some key early victories, such as the capture of the [[House Panteer|Alderaanian royal family]], and set its sights on seizing the planet's capital city.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

[[File:BattleOfAlderaan-TORHope.png|thumb|right|260px|Republic and Imperial forces battle for the fate of Alderaan]]
In one of the planet's many lush forests, the force being personally commanded by Malgus was set upon by Havoc Squad. The skirmish initially appeared to be an Imperial victory, until backup led by Jedi Satele Shan arrived.<ref name="Hope" />

Shan and Malgus dueled once more, more than a decade after their first encounter above Korriban, while Republic and Imperial troops fought each other for survival and control of the planet. Shan and the Republic troops ultimately proved victorious, driving the invading Imperial army from the planet and critically wounding Darth Malgus in the process.<ref name="Hope" />

Despite his injuries, Malgus escaped from the planet as well, but the hour was the Republic's. In the months after the victory at Alderaan, the Republic scored a string of victories, including the liberation of a number of systems in the Mid Rim as well as regaining a foothold in the Minos Cluster.<ref name="Gnost" />

====New strategies====
With the defeat at Alderaan and its advance toward the Core seemingly stalled, the Empire began working on a new tactic to employ.<ref name="Timeline 4" /> Operatives of the [[Ministry of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial intelligence service]] recognized the potential of bringing a powerful ally into the war and set to work on recruiting them. In centuries past, the Emperor [[Mandalorian Wars|had used the Mandalorians to attack the Republic]],<ref name="Revan" /> and the opportunity presented itself once more.

Imperial agents selected a [[Mandalore the Lesser|powerful combatant]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and did everything in their power to aid in his rise, engaging in activities from gladiator management to outright poisoning of his opponents. As this warrior's star was in ascendance, Imperial agents began to spread the idea that he could be the new [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] and unite the scattered clans. Their plan proved fruitful, and this warrior was able to establish himself as the galaxy's most powerful warrior and claim the title of Mandalore&ndash;though at some point, he became a willing servant of the Empire.<ref name="Timeline 4" />

As the war approached its third decade, both Republic and Empire also sought to gain advantage by debuting powerful new starships and experimental [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]]. In [[3665 BBY]], 16 years into the war, the two militaries [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|clashed]] over [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Gnost" />

Many starships from both sides were destroyed in the battle, including one carrying captured Jedi Master [[Wyellett]]. Much of the wreckage rained down on the frigid planet below, providing fertile pickings for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the years to come.<ref name="TOR" /> The battle was particularly devastating to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], which had still not fully recovered three years later when the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|Mandalorian blockade]] began.<ref name="Gnost" />

====The Mandalorian blockade====
[[File:Republicnavy.jpg|thumb|left|260px|A small Republic fleet during the Mandalorian Blockade.]]

After uniting the scattered Mandalorian clans, the new Mandalore encouraged his followers to make war upon the Republic and confront the greatest challenge of all&mdash;fighting the legendary Jedi Knights. Following orders from his Sith superiors, he ordered the Mandalorian fleet to blockade the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], the Republic's most critical trade route.<ref name="Timeline 3" />

With the Mandalorian blockade in place, the Republic found themselves with no raw goods or supplies to feed the countless trillions of sentients in the Core Worlds. After several pleas from the Republic, a Jedi attack attempted to break the blockade, but was soundly defeated and forced to retreat to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]].<ref name="Timeline 3" />

The Mandalorians continued the blockade, denying the Republic raw goods and handicapping the Republic's war effort. Eventually, [[Coruscant riots (3661 BBY)|riots broke out]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the Senate began to discuss the possibility of surrendering to the Sith.<ref name="Timeline 2" />

[[File:Mandalorian_Blockade_is_broken.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Mandalorian Blockade is broken.]]
An unlikely hero proved to be the savior of the Core Worlds. [[Hylo Visz]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] motivated by the possibility of great profit in a time of dire need, organized a [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent|smuggler fleet]] to defeat the blockade and enrich herself in the process. After loading up large freighters with resources from the Outer Rim, Visz moved them to approach the blockade and hold position close by. The Mandalorians' hails went ignored and so they moved to attack the freighters, and Visz's trap was sprung. A fleet of smuggler starships dropped out of hyperspace behind the Mandalorians and began laying waste to the blockade. The Republic SIS, who had been monitoring the situation, rushed Republic and Jedi ships in to assist in the fight.<ref name="Gnost" /><ref name="Timeline 2" />

The Mandalorian blockade was broken, and whether during the attack or shortly afterward, Mandalore was slain. Though a [[Mandalore the Vindicated|new Mandalore]] of uncertain allegiance took his place, the Mandalorians ceased to be a military threat to the Republic for the remainder of the war.<ref name="Gnost" /><ref name="Timeline 2" />

====Battle of Ord Radama====
Sometime later, Imperial forces commanded by [[Darth Venemal]] and Malgus [[Battle of Ord Radama|attacked]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] in the Outer Rim. The assault was an initial success, as the Sith led their forces to capture the planet's [[Livien Magnus|capital]] city. Holding their conquest, however, would prove to be much more challenging than capturing it had been.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

Weeks went by with no resupplies arriving for the Imperial forces. Eventually Republic reinforcements arrived in orbit and destroyed the Imperial fleet tasked there. Damage taken by one of Malgus' [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class Dreadnoughts]] sent it plummeting into the planetary atmosphere, and it crashed into the capital city&ndash;destroying it utterly. With Republic victory certain and Darth Venemal killed, the Sith forces withdrew.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

====Republic counter-attack====
After the Republic victories over the Mandalorian blockade and at Ord Radama, Republic forces pressed the advantage back into Imperial-held space. Republic strike groups made attacks on Korriban, which Malgus believed to be only feints, while a larger Republic fleet amassed over the Imperial world [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

Republic forces [[Battle of Ziost|laid siege to the planet]], hoping to establish an important foothold inside Imperial space. The [[Ziost system/Legends|Ziost system]] was within striking distance of the very heart of the Empire; both Korriban and the capital world, Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

After several months of fighting, Imperial forces regained the upper hand and forced the Republic off the planet.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

===The Imperial advance continues===
{{Quote|You were deceived. And now, your Republic shall fall.|Darth Malgus|audio=YouWereDeceivedRepublicShallFall.flac|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
[[File:Ven_Zallow_Great_Galactic_War.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Jedi Master Ven Zallow during a battle of the Great Galactic War]]
With Ziost defended, the Empire once more turned back on the offensive. Malgus, personally guaranteed by the Dark Council to never again face supply shortages, turned his attention on the Outer Rim world [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Malgus had learned from Imperial Intelligence that a Jedi Master, [[Ven Zallow]], and his contingent had established themselves there. It was feared that Serenno was a staging ground for establishing a more strategic position, and so Malgus ordered one of the Empire's infiltrators, a high-ranking noble, to do his bidding. Malgus prepared to use his new agent to assassinate Zallow and begin the Jedi's undoing on Serenno. Moving quickly, Malgus ordered his agent to strike while he mobilized the Imperial fleet under his command. The mission was a partial victory. Zallow had slain the infiltrator and escaped on one of the Republic's ships, but [[Battle of Serenno|Serenno had been taken]] with a minimal of effort and resources expended. Serenno did not welcome the Imperial presence, but Malgus soon put an end to any thoughts of rebellion. Assassins supplied by the Dark Council were unleashed upon the world, and massacred all those who would dare to defy Imperial rule.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

A few short months later, Malgus was ordered by the Sith Emperor to [[Reconquest of Ord Radama|recapture Ord Radama]] and avenge the previous Imperial defeat there. Leaving nothing to chance, Malgus decided to personally command a regiment of Force-strong combatants as they moved on the planet's new capital city, [[New Raido]]. The battle dragged on for months, more bloody than the first time the powers had clashed over the planet. Jedi traps repeatedly confounded Imperial efforts, while Malgus enjoyed the bloodbath of wholesale slaughter of both sides.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

Near the end of the war, [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] was [[Battle of Rhen Var|invaded by Imperial forces]] under the command of the Sith Lord [[Darth Mekhis]]. The swift invasion took the world by storm and the Imperial forces devastated the troops of the Republic. Imperial victory there, however, would ultimately prove to be short-lived. The remaining Republic troops were rallied by a group of Jedi led by Satele Shan, and drove the Imperial forces back in one of the Republic's last victories of the war.

====Sacking of Coruscant====
{{Quote|It's all going to burn.|Darth Malgus, right before killing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]]|<ref name="DeceivedBook">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>}}
With the Sith Empire's military advance toward the Core halted, Imperial tactics became far more aggressive and desperate as the war entered its third decade. Seven years after the defeat of the Empire's Mandalorian allies at the Hydian Way, the Dark Council stunned the Republic by offering the chance to negotiate a [[Treaty of Coruscant|peace treaty]].<ref name="Timeline 1" />

[[File:Cold_War.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Sacking of Coruscant was the decisive move which ended the war]]
Fearing a ruse, the Jedi Council formally recommended that the Senate ignore the overture, but they were ignored. However, Senators and Jedi alike did agree that the war could not be won and that, if nothing else, peace negotiations would offer their war-weary troops a respite. At the Senate's request, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Zym]] agreed to send a contingent of Jedi with the peace delegation,<ref name="Gnost" /> and diplomats from both sides traveled to Alderaan to discuss terms.<ref name="Timeline 1" /> But the Empire's peace overture was indeed a deception.

Even while Republic and Imperial negotiators talked on Alderaan, a large Sith fleet [[Sacking of Coruscant|invaded and sacked Coruscant]] itself, the heart of the Republic. As a team of Sith warriors led by Darth Malgus attacked the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and slaughtered all within, the fleet, led by [[Darth Angral]], bombarded and invaded the planet. Once Coruscant's planetary defenses were destroyed, the Sith destroyed the Jedi Temple outright and blockaded the planet to hold its inhabitants hostage.<ref name="Timeline 1" />

With the galactic capital firmly under Sith control, Angral traveled down to the surface and stormed the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] himself. Once inside, he personally executed Supreme Chancellor [[Berooken]] and claimed the office as his own command center for the duration of the occupation.<ref name="DeceivedBook" />

===Treaty of Coruscant===
[[File:Treaty_of_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Imperial and Republic diplomats agree to the Treaty of Coruscant]]
{{Quote|We can be certain of nothing until contact is reestablished with Coruscant. In the meantime, we have no choice but to accept the Empire's terms.|Jedi Grand Master Zym, to the Republic delegation at the [[Alderaan peace conference]]|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref>}}
Faced with no alternatives, the Republic diplomats on Alderaan were forced to agree to the Treaty of Coruscant. The treaty mandated that all Jedi and Republic forces stand down from combat duties and withdraw into Republic space. It also demanded that the Republic recognize the Empire as the legitimate ruler of half the galaxy, and that the Republic cede to the Empire a number of worlds that had not been conquered by Imperial forces.<ref name="Timeline 1" />

While the Republic still stood, the Sith Empire had claimed a decisive victory in the war.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Thus began the unprecedented stalemate. The Jedi reconnecting with their roots, the Republic nursing its wounds, the Sith consolidating their power in a galaxy divided between darkness and light.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=ColdWarStalemate.flac|<ref name="Timeline 1" />}}
[[File:TreatyofCoruscantborders.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The division of worlds agreed upon in the treaty.]]
The treaty forced the Republic to give up many outlying systems to the Sith Empire.

However, there were forces in the Republic that didn't accept the treaty. There were Republic troops, namely on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and Balmorra, who refused to withdraw and mutinied to continue the war while another group within the Republic, led by the Jedi Master [[Dar'Nala]], bombed the Senate building to assassinate the Senators who supported the treaty, believing them to be Imperial spies, while also planning on ruining the treaty. Dar'Nala also orchestrated a supposed Sith attack on the [[Envoy (Republic transport ship)|''Envoy'']] in an attempt to neutralize the treaty. However, when Dar'Nala [[Skirmish in the Ancient Crystal Cave|attempted]] to put the last phase of her plan into action, her madness was revealed to her supporters and they abandoned her, which led to her death.<ref name="Threat of Peace" /> The peace held through after this.<ref name="TOR" />

Although his Empire was stronger than ever, the Sith Emperor no longer seemed to desire total conquest. He handed over control of the Empire to the Dark Council, who would oversee the day-to-day affairs of state, and went on to pursue his own mysterious goals as the Sith consolidated their power.<ref name="Timeline 1" />

By the end of the war, thousands of Jedi were dead. The Galactic Republic focused its anger on the Jedi, blaming the Order for its defeat at the hands of the Sith. Though they were still committed to defending the Republic, the surviving Jedi chose to return to their ancient homeworld of Tython in order to rebuild their strength.<ref name="Timeline 1" />

The end of the Great Galactic War set the stage for a Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic in the years that followed. The Cold War saw a number of border skirmishes and proxy wars, eventually pushing the Sith Empire [[Galactic War|back into open war]] with the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TOR" />
